description: Specification of the Inno Setup Preprocessor (ISPP): its directives, predefined variables and built-in functions used by the plugin for completion, validation and documentation.

predefined_variables.description: List of variables predefined by the preprocessor and available without prior definition.

builtin_functions.description: List of functions provided by the preprocessor that can be called within expressions.

forbidden_variables_name.description: List of reserved ISPP keywords that must not be used as a #define (or other macro) name.

fileTargets.description: Set of file types a rule applies to: "iss" (script) and/or "isl" (language file).

directive.description: A single preprocessor directive starting with '#' (e.g. #define, #include).

syntax.description: Full usage syntax of the directive (e.g. "#define <name> [<value>]").

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what the directive does, shown in documentation and tooltips.

deprecated.description: File types in which this directive is deprecated (e.g. ["iss", "isl"]). Empty = not deprecated.

since.description: Inno Setup / ISPP version in which this directive was introduced (e.g. "6.0.0").

until.description: Inno Setup / ISPP version up to which this directive is supported; absent if still current.

variable.description: A single variable predefined by the preprocessor.

name.description: Variable name as referenced in the script (e.g. "__FILE__", "__LINE__").

type.description: Data type of the variable's value: "int" for integers, "str" for strings, or "void" for valueless macros.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what the variable holds, shown in documentation and tooltips.

since.description: Inno Setup / ISPP version in which this variable was introduced (e.g. "6.0.0").

until.description: Inno Setup / ISPP version up to which this variable is supported; absent if still current.

function.description: A single built-in preprocessor function callable within expressions.

name.description: Function name as called in the script (e.g. "GetEnv", "FileExists").

signature.description: Full call signature including parameters and return type (e.g. "GetEnv(Name: str): str").

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what the function does, shown in documentation and tooltips.

since.description: Inno Setup / ISPP version in which this function was introduced (e.g. "6.0.0").

until.description: Inno Setup / ISPP version up to which this function is supported; absent if still current.

forbiddenName.description: A single reserved ISPP keyword that cannot be used as a macro name.

name.description: Reserved keyword, matched case-insensitively against macro names (e.g. "defined", "int").

description.description: Human-readable reason why the name is reserved, shown in documentation and tooltips.

since.description: Inno Setup / ISPP version in which this name became reserved (e.g. "6.0.0").

until.description: Inno Setup / ISPP version up to which this name is reserved; absent if still current.
